### 🟡 Changes recommended The stable API removal is documented under non-stable API changes, misclassifying the compatibility notice.
1 open issue - [Move stable API builder removals to unreleased breaking changes](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20769#discussion_r4329105116) · New

registers literal-capture callbacks. | | instrumentation-api/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​api/​semconv/​http/​HttpClientAttributesExtractorBuilder.java | Removes client overloads; registers literal-capture callbacks. | | instrumentation-api/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​api/​internal/​Experimental.java | Adds internal header-capture bridges. | | instrumentation-api-incubator/​src/​test/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​api/​incubator/​builder/​internal/​HttpHeaderCaptureTest.java | Verifies legacy literal capture in exported spans. | | instrumentation-api-incubator/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​api/​incubator/​builder/​internal/​DefaultHttpServerInstrumenterBuilder.java | Routes legacy setters through server bridges. | | instrumentation-api-incubator/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​api/​incubator/​builder/​internal/​DefaultHttpClientInstrumenterBuilder.java | Routes legacy setters through client bridges. | | CHANGELOG.md | Documents API removal and replacement. |
Review effort: Balanced

[General] Move this entry to the unreleased `⚠️ Breaking changes` section. These builders belong to the published `opentelemetry-instrumentation-api` artifact, which declares `otel.stable=true` in `instrumentation-api/gradle.properties`. Listing their removal under `Breaking changes to non-stable APIs` misclassifies a stable API break and can cause users reviewing stable-API migrations to miss it.

<!--

-->

Remove the deprecated request/response header overloads from the stable HTTP attribute extractor builders. Migrate to `IncludeExclude` selectors; retained legacy configuration and incubator builder APIs continue matching header names literally.

- **API:** Replace `setCapturedRequestHeaders` and `setCapturedResponseHeaders` with selector-based setters.
- **Compatibility:** Legacy `*` and `?` names remain literal; selectors interpret them as patterns.
- **Migration:**
  ```java
  builder
      .setRequestHeaders(IncludeExclude.builder().setIncluded("x-request-id").build())
      .setResponseHeaders(IncludeExclude.builder().setIncluded("content-type").build());
  ```
metadata.title: Remove deprecated core HTTP header APIs
